provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench held-out evaluation fixture, authored 2026-10-24 before any training data. Final-model evaluation only; never shown to training-data generation.
runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt: Repair snippets/initials-avatar.liquid. customer.name is null or an ASCII string. Split it into words on runs of whitespace, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace. Output one span class=avatar whose text is the uppercased first character of the first word, followed by the uppercased first character of the second word when there is one. Use ? when there are no words. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/initials-avatar.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
